rules.alternatives: Renewal requires verifying compliance with NCCPA continuing medical education standards; a PA whose NCCPA certification lapses is not considered licensed.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal in the birth month of each odd-numbered year. Inactive license ($70) does not require NCCPA certification.
rules.rule_quote: A. Every licensed physician assistant intending to continue to practice shall biennially renew the license in each odd-numbered year in the licensee's birth month by: 1. Returning the renewal form and fee as prescribed by the board; and 2. Verifying compliance with continuing medical education standards established by the NCCPA.
